body:
IGN: IceyPoop
Reason For Ban: Hacking, Kill Aura, Fly, Anti KB
Why I should be unbanned from this server: I should be unbanned because I will not do this again. I did not know what hacking did to other players and how it affected them. This is my first time every being banned for hacking. I hacked on a small server before and was not banned. Hacking on a bigger server got me banned. I have learned my lesson and I will not hack again. I am sorry for hacking on your server I will remove my hacks now.

Thanks,
IceyPoop
